programmes.show_description: An Advancement of Learning: Warren Clarke stars as the detective duo tackle another mystery. A shocking find is made when a memorial to the former principal of a college is taken.
A High Profile: Look out for Dominic Monaghan, 'Merry' in the Lord of the Rings trilogy, here in an early role in the gentle crime drama. Hetty takes on a case for a worried mother.
Disappearance at Oare: A young widow hires Pearl to investigate when she receives an anonymous note claiming that her husband did not take his own life seven years ago.
Love and Other Puzzles: When local resident Hillary is found dead, face covered in cold cream next to an unfinished jigsaw, it becomes clear to Boniface a pattern's forming across cases.

Trusting the Enemy: Beech calls in a favour to help Rickman embarrass an old enemy.
New. You'll Be a Man My Son: A patient with Alzheimer's disease mistakes Archie for his son, and a boy behaves inappropriately toward Michelle.
New. Fall Upon Your Sword: Julia aids a couple suffering a downturn in fortune, while Melody, feeling she has been unfairly treated by Nick, asks George to review her case.
Wants and Needs: On the day of the christening, Chrissie has a shocking announcement for Owen. Will faces a tough decision and Jess feels overjoyed about her relationship with Zubin.
Boys Will Be Boys: Kirsty faces unwelcome inquiries from the police, who are investigating Warren's accident, while Jay's concentration is affected by the discovery of a testicular lump.
Trusting the Enemy: Beech calls in a favour to help Rickman embarrass an old enemy.
New. Masood considers fleeing to a new life with unsuspecting Jane, while Ronnie gives Billy good news unaware that he could still lose everything. Ben's plan backfires.
New. Syed hits rock bottom. Ian decides to give Jane exactly what she wants. Meanwhile, Roxy tries to cheer Christian up.
Big Fish, Little Fish: Laughs and tears with the Yorkshire vets. Siegfried befriends Colin when one of his goldfish dies, and James turns out for the local cricket team.
Gerald and Charles clash over Abby, Sir Edward's will causes problems and David continues his attempts to woo Laura.
Safe as Houses: Lord of the Rings star Dominic Monaghan guests in the quirky mystery series. An old friend gives Hetty her most baffling case yet; to help a woman keep her baby.
The Lost Weekend: Dorien steals the show yet again in the Essex girl comedy. The girls decide to spend a weekend away from home, but trouble strikes before they make a booking!
Earnshaw Strikes Again: Come enjoy the antics of three old men savouring their autumn years in picturesque Yorkshire. Clegg doesn't want to raise the spectre of a local myth.
Here We Go into the Wild Blue Yonder: Those three old men of the Yorkshire Pennines rustle up more comedy and fun. Compo considers taking up a dangerous sport to impress Nora.
Here We Go Again into the Wild Blue Yonder: Another visit to the three old boys enjoying a second boyhood in a Yorkshire village. Compo is about to take to the air. Watch out!
A gripping PD James murder mystery. When a trustee is found murdered at the Dupayne family museum, Adam Dalgliesh finds himself investigating a web of secrecy.
Mad Dogs: The hugely popular crime caper teaming up Likely Lad James Bolam with Minder Dennis Waterman. The team re-investigate the medical trial death of soldier Eric Trimble.
An Autumn Shroud: Crime-cracking action. Dalziel goes on a holiday in East Anglia and finds himself drawn into a conspiracy at a country house. Francesca Annis guest stars.
Safe as Houses: Lord of the Rings star Dominic Monaghan guests in the quirky mystery series. An old friend gives Hetty her most baffling case yet; to help a woman keep her baby.
A Cup O'Kindness: Pearl investigates when a mother takes her daughter out for a boat ride and the pair need rescuing after the craft is sabotaged.
My Brother's Keeper: Sister Reginald's ex-con brother Alfie shows up at the convent. The sisters agree to let him stay, but when an artist is found murdered, all eyes are on Alfie.

Loyalty: Comedy with Chigwell's most famous siblings. The future of the cafe hangs in the balance as Tracey decides whether to put up her house as collateral.
On the Wagon: Is Carver really on the wagon, or have his colleagues reason to doubt him?
New. Face in the Crowd: George is torn between two women claiming to be the mother of the same boy, and Vivien rejects Jimmi's offer of help.
New. Served Cold: Nick treats a man attacked by his wife for being unfaithful, while Melody worries about what happened between Daniel and herself.
Great Expectations: Mickie's midwife mother comes into the ward with a home birth patient, but they find working together difficult. Carlos makes a shocking discovery about Tricia.
Less Than Zero: Nita tries to run away and joins a woman fleeing to Scarborough with her brother. Jay feels stressed after the cancer scare and receives an unwelcome visit from Maryam.
On the Wagon: Is Carver really on the wagon, or have his colleagues reason to doubt him?
New. Zainab takes drastic measures to cut Syed out of her life. Ronnie finds a bit of goodness in her heart and Ian's plans are thwarted when he receives bad news from the bank.
New. Phil is panicked as Louise goes missing. Danny has a wicked plan to take Roxy for all she is worth, and Masood stands up for the most important thing in his life.
In Whom We Trust: Cosy drama in the ageless series based on the real life stories of a Yorkshire vet. An old friend of James and Siegfried's appears to be stealing from them.
Jack and Vanessa's wedding day approaches, and it becomes clear the bride-to-be's brother is a con artist. Meanwhile, Abby is quite happy to accept Sir Edward's money.
Poison Pen: Patricia Routledge takes a break from playing Hyacinth Bucket in the mystery series. While Hetty helps a village, can Robert and Geoffrey solve their own case?
Poetic Justice: Comedy with the Chigwell sisters and their man-mad neighbour. On a prison visit to the Isle of Wight, Dorien finally meets Chris.
In the Service of Humanity: A vintage episode of the comedy about the three naughty old men from Yorkshire. Clegg and Compo are dismayed when Foggy gets into first aid.
Car and Garter: More laughs with the trio of irrepressible oldsters. In order to enhance Sid's marital status, Foggy, Clegg and Compo decide to create a glamorous image for him.
The Odd Dog Men: The world's longest-running sitcom. A chance encounter with an unwilling and resentful dog-walker suggests to Foggy that this might be a business opportunity.
The Cat of Mastigatus: An investigation gets under way when a girl is left for dead at a boys school fete. Mark Williams stars in this drama, based on the stories by GK Chesterton.
Queen of the Kitchen: Celebrity cook, Prunella Gladwell, brings her TV baking show to Great Slaughter. But the programme takes a sour turn when Gladys Tibbs is poisoned by her own cake.
The War Against Drugs: Adventures with those amiable middle-aged sleuths. Brian reluctantly goes into rehab, but is soon investigating the death of a drug addict at the clinic.
